question: What was the literacy rate of India as per the Census of 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __74.04%.____ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The results of the 2011 census revealed that there has been an increase in literacy in the country.

 
 
• The literacy rate in the country is 74.04 per cent, 82.14 for males and 65.46 for females.
 
 
 
• The literacy rate of females in rural areas has observed an improvement in literacy rate about 24%.
 
• The male and female literacy rate was highest in Kerala and lowest in Bihar.
 
• The gap in literacy rates of females and males was low in Meghalaya, Kerala, and Mizoram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A census is an official data of the population.
 
• Indian census includes demographic, social, and economic data.
 
• It is held periodically after every tenth year.
 
• The first census took place in 1872.
